propositions: Reopening a closed child does not cascade to reopen its closed parent(s), leaving an invalid state of closed parent with open child.
The transition cascade only fires on open -> in_progress edge but not on closed -> open edge, creating an asymmetry with the close-time open-children guard.
The existing _cascade_open_parent helper can be generalized to drive both cascading edges (open->in_progress and closed->open) via an edge table rather than duplicating cascade logic.
A benign race where the parent moves between the cascade decision and the write can abort the child incorrectly; the cascade must re-check the parent's live status on failure like claim_compute does.

The cascade must be sequential, fail-fast, and non-transactional: a genuine parent failure aborts the child with exit code preserved, but a parent that succeeded before child failure is not rolled back.
